item.title: BARNSLEY FC PROUD TO SUPPORT 'UNITE FOR ACCESS'
item.description: Barnsley Football Club is proud to be involved in 'Unite For Access' – a celebration of access and inclusion for disabled sports fans. The Level Playing Field campaign will bring sporting communities across England and Wales together at matchdays throughout between February 28 and March 15. There are more than 16 million disabled people in the UK, representing almost a quarter of the population, as the largest minority.
